title: Why Do We Honor Fathers?
text: write this down important verse Ephesians 6:13 says children now I wanted to bring this in quickly because there's some of you sitting there going if you knew my father you would never honor him but I got some news for you listen carefully the Bible distinguishes between a parent and a father father and mother write it down please a parent is not normally equal to father and mother they can be different for example some of you were bought up by your grandparent but your father is still your father and your mother is still your mother your grandmother could never be your motheread and your grandfather or your stepfather can never be your father they can be your parent but not your father anybody still with me God is so smart God never told us to love your father he never says love your mother he just simply says honor honor doesn't mean to love because some folks the stuff they did or didn't do makes it hard for you to love them he never told you to love them he said honor your father honor your mother he didn't even say to obey your father because your father may be doing things you shouldn't do that's right anybody still here he didn't say obey your mother cuz your mother may be living a lifestyle that God disagrees with or your father may ask you to do some things that are completely against God's Will and God said you got disobey him he never told you to obey your father but watch what he says in Ephesians 6 he says children obey who your parents
